title: A rate-limited provider triggers bounded jittered retry and returns one adapter result on budget exhaustion
asA: operator whose project is receiving rate-limit refusals from the provider
iWant: the adapter to retry inside a bounded budget with jittered backoff and then surface one clean failure
soThat: a transient rate-limit refusal converts to a bounded delay rather than a retry storm the caller has to defend against

acceptanceCriteria.description: On a `RESEND_RATE_LIMITED` provider return the adapter retries with exponential backoff and full jitter and stops on either a successful attempt or the configured retry budget, whichever comes first; the number of SMTP submissions equals `1 + observed_retries` and observed_retries is at most the configured budget (default 2).
acceptanceCriteria.given: a running project instrumented to count SMTP submissions and a provider seam that returns rate-limited on the first attempt and accepts on a later attempt within the budget
acceptanceCriteria.when: the magic-link route triggers one adapter send
acceptanceCriteria.then: the submission counter after the adapter returns equals `1 + observed_retries`, `observed_retries` is at least one and at most the configured budget, and the returned object has `ok === true`

acceptanceCriteria.description: When every attempt in the budget window returns rate-limited, the adapter returns exactly one result with `ok: false`, `error` starting with `RESEND_RATE_LIMITED`, and the submission counter equals `1 + configured_budget`.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a running project with a provider seam that returns rate-limited on every attempt and configured retry budget of 2
acceptanceCriteria.when: the magic-link route triggers one adapter send
acceptanceCriteria.then: the adapter returns once, `ok === false`, `error` starts with `RESEND_RATE_LIMITED`, and the SMTP submission counter equals 3

acceptanceCriteria.description: On a `RESEND_SENDER_UNVERIFIED` or `RESEND_RECIPIENT_REJECTED` provider return the adapter does not retry; the submission counter after the adapter returns equals 1.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a running project with a provider seam that returns the terminal-invalid class on the first attempt
acceptanceCriteria.when: the magic-link route triggers one adapter send
acceptanceCriteria.then: the submission counter equals 1 and the returned object has `ok === false` with `error` starting with the terminal class code
